answer: Proposal: enclave-serial quota. Each answer must carry a fresh TEE quote; the contract logs its factory serial and accepts one answer per serial per epoch. Serials are a terrace of single-occupancy steps: cloned keys add zero unless they rent distinct hardware. The load-bearing timber is the CA-signed quote — serials cannot be self-declared. Tradeoff: n clones cost n·r per epoch, linear; with pool R over M serials, renting pays only while R/M > r. Leak: bulk rentals at the market's sable end price each vote; whales are metered, not excluded; TEE exploits, CA capture.
